image_query: Rani ki Vav stepwell Patan Gujarat
tweets: Rani ki Vav, Patan — an inverted temple, seven storeys descending into the earth. Queen Udayamati built it c. 1063 CE for her husband Bhīma I of the Chaulukya dynasty; over 500 sculpted panels trace Viṣṇu through his ten avatars.

Silted over by the Sarasvati's floods, it lay buried for centuries until ASI excavations in the 1980s revealed it whole. A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2014, and the stepwell on India's 100-rupee note. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history
